title: Listing Quality Outcomes and Payout Methods Re-Send Holdbacks
content:
The recent quality assessments of a host's Listings bear on how much of a returned balance is re-sent to the host's Payout Methods ahead of the next scheduled run. The re-send listing-quality holdback looks at the quality assessments of the host's listings dated less than 3 whole months before the re-send: 5 percent when any of them has the outcome suspension, 2 percent when none is a suspension but any has the outcome warning, and nothing otherwise. The holdback is a percentage of the held balance, kept for the next scheduled run.

## Outcome table

| Quality assessments of any of the host's listings in the 3-month window | Listing-quality holdback, percent of the held balance |
|---|---|
| At least one with the outcome suspension | 5 percent |
| No suspension, at least one with the outcome warning | 2 percent |
| Only other outcomes (pass, not assessed), or no assessment in the window | Nothing |

The holdback is set once for the host, however many listings or assessments show the outcome: one suspension anywhere in the window gives 5 percent, and warnings do not add to it.

## What is read

- **Records:** the quality assessment entries in the Listings records of every listing the host holds, each with its outcome and its date.
- **Window:** assessments dated less than 3 whole months before the re-send. An assessment dated exactly 3 whole months before the re-send is outside the window.

## Hypothetical cases (re-send dated 2026-08-20)

| Assessments of the host's listings | Holdback |
|---|---|
| Listing A: warning on 2026-07-01; listing B: pass on 2026-07-01 | 2 percent |
| Listing A: warning on 2026-07-01; listing B: suspension on 2026-05-21 | 5 percent |
| Listing A: suspension on 2026-05-20 (exactly 3 whole months earlier); listing B: pass on 2026-07-01 | Nothing |
| No assessment in the window | Nothing |
